LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing1.label: First Feather
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing1.description: Awaken the power of flower, sword and bow, improving weapon damage, armor penetration and melee attack speed.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing2.label: Light Within the Blade
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing2.description: Further improve the power of all three weapon forms.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing3.label: Feather Law's Edge
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing3.description: Fully unleash the damage, armor penetration and melee attack speed of all three weapon forms.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow1.label: Scattered Feathers
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow1.description: Increase the number of projectiles in ordinary split-arrow attacks and Arrow Barrage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow2.label: Skywoven Formation
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow2.description: Unfurl more feather arrows to expand sustained fire.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow3.label: A Hundred Feathers Return
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow3.description: Fully unleash ordinary split-arrow attacks and Arrow Barrage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo1.label: Faint Halo
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo1.description: Unlock protection against the first hit and a six-charge shield. After the charges run out, the shield needs time to recover.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo2.label: Sheltering Halos
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo2.description: Increase the shield to eighteen charges.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo3.label: Clear Sky's Echo
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo3.description: Fully unleash the charge shield and unlock the Stage III damage-absorption and buff cycle. Weakness follows the cycle.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law1.label: Faint Patterns
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law1.description: Awaken the laws within the everyday attire, inner layer and earrings, improving protection and restoring some equipment bonuses.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law2.label: Resonant Patterns
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law2.description: Further improve the attire's protection, insulation and equipment bonuses.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law3.label: Raiment Restored
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law3.description: Fully unleash the protection, insulation and equipment bonuses of the everyday attire, inner layer and earrings.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing1.story: As a feather brushes her palm, Neiyu remembers the weight of the first weapon she held. Keeping power upon the blade is harder than letting it pour forth.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing2.story: She wipes the faint light along the blade's spine. Its restrained brilliance blooms only at the moment of impact.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing3.story: Flower, sword and bow appear in her hands in turn. Their forms differ, but the same law always answers her.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow1.story: An arrow leaves the string, unfurling feathers of light. Neiyu begins to distinguish each faint echo.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow2.story: After the rain, threads of light cross the sky. Their interwoven paths slowly fall into order.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow3.story: The sky's feather-light returns to the string, as still as if it had never left. At last, she can guide every feather to its own destination.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo1.story: The halo above her head trembles softly. She keeps the first answering strand of light outside her body.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo2.story: Thin layers of light close one after another. With every impact, she hears them ring in different places.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo3.story: The halo bears one last heavy blow, then folds inward. Neiyu raises her head as the gathered light flows along her wings and back to the blade's tip.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law1.story: The fabric's patterns reveal themselves only in the light. Following them, she reconnects the scattered power inch by inch.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law2.story: Her earrings and hem glow softly together. Once separate, the patterns begin to rise and fall with her breath.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law3.story: She folds her wings, and the light upon her clothes fades with them. The law now rests against her body, with no need to proclaim itself.
